units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 4a">B. Bath. 4ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אתי חבריה ולָיֵיף ביה</he> (ed. <he>ל׳ ליה חבריה</he>) his neighbor may go to work and join (a front) to the hedge (v. <cite ref="H00547"><he>חָזִית</he></cite>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="L00454"><he>לָיִיף</he></cite>, <cite ref="L00506"><he>לִיף</he></cite>, pl. <he>לָיְיפֵי</he>, <he>לִיפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 11a:7">Ḥull. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>היכא דל׳</he> when it remains joined (to the body), opp. <he>חתיך לגמרי</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 107a:3">Ib. 107ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵילַף לָיְיפֵי</he> (fr. <cite ref="L00647"><he>לְפַף</he></cite>) the waters are considered as connected.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 100b">B. Mets. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>בדלייפי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>בדיילפי</he>, corr. acc.; Ms. M. <he>בדלפי</he>, Ms. H. a. oth. <he>בדלִיפי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) when the goods are not yet cut.
<cite ref="Shevuot 43a:15">Shebu. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>בדלייפי</he> (Ms. F. <he>בדליפי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5) when the girdle consists of pieces sewed together.
